climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A DO in the south of Castile-La Mancha, grouped with La Mancha as La Mancha & Valdepeñas. It is almost surrounded by the La Mancha DO but separate because of its long history of a distinct style, aloque or clarete, made by mixing white and red grapes. Rules allow Tempranillo, Airén and Garnacha Tinta, among others.
